# Toolbar

Toolbar with filters and search on the left and actions on the right, wrapping when space runs out. The gap is
fixed at step 3.

**Category**: Patterns · **Common uses**: Search, filters and bulk actions above a list; title rows of split panes

## Import

```ts
import { Toolbar } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

Filters and search on the left, actions on the right.

```tsx
export function Basic() {
  return (
    <Toolbar actions={<Button>Export</Button>}>
      <Input.Search placeholder="Search" allowClear />
      <Select
        placeholder="Status"
        allowClear
        options={[
          { value: 'active', label: 'Active' },
          { value: 'archived', label: 'Archived' },
        ]}
      />
    </Toolbar>
  )
}
```

## Variants

### View switch

```tsx
export function ViewSwitch() {
  return (
    <Toolbar actions={<Segmented options={['Grid', 'List']} />}>
      <Input.Search placeholder="Search by file name" allowClear />
    </Toolbar>
  )
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | Left side: search field, filters, view switching and so on. | — | No |
| `actions` | `ReactNode` | Right side: actions related to the current view. | — | No |

Also accepts `testId` (rendered as `data-testid`), `aria-label`, `role` and `id`, like all primitives.

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.
